privacy.Pesepay or Paynow (when configured) and: Pesepay, Paynow and the selected financial provider process payment authorisation for the methods available in Opus Pay. Card details are entered on the payment provider’s checkout. We retain the order, provider reference, amount, currency, status and verification details needed to administer your payment. Do not give our staff or assistant your mobile-money PIN, banking password or card security code. Approval codes entered in a designated wallet payment flow are used for that request; they should not be sent in chat.
privacy.The currently deployed inbox supports ma: Opus provides AI-assisted enquiries and business automation alongside human support. AI-assisted replies are generated automatically and are distinct from replies personally written by a human. For conversations handled by an assistant, relevant messages, supplied images or a brief are processed by the AI provider supporting that feature to help answer or organise the request. AI-assisted WhatsApp replies and human replies use the business messaging integration and remain subject to Meta’s rules and account availability. You can request human assistance or ask us to stop optional messaging.
privacy.Examples in our current operations inclu: Examples in our current operations include Cloudflare, Pesepay, Paynow, Meta’s WhatsApp platform and Resend; the provider used for a particular domain or hosting service can vary.
privacy.Where enabled and appropriate, an AI pro: AI providers process the relevant information used by our AI-assisted features. This does not mean every support conversation is sent to an AI provider. Provider terms govern their processing; we do not promise a confidentiality, training or retention arrangement that their applicable terms do not support.
privacy.Our site and infrastructure may use esse: Our site uses essential cookies and browser storage for security, authenticated administrative access, website conversations, checkout and reliable operation. A shared preference cookie records the essential-only choice across opuszim.co.zw and payments.opuszim.co.zw for 180 days. It contains a preference value, not payment details or login credentials. Closing the notice alone dismisses it without saving that choice; cookie preferences can be reopened from the footer. The site also uses browser storage and content-version signals to refresh website content, while private checkout or document access can depend on a temporary capability token.
privacy.We do not describe optional advertising: No optional advertising or tracking cookies are enabled by the current preference control. Cloudflare provides cookieless website performance and usage measurements; saving the essential-only preference does not switch those measurements off. Any future non-essential technology requiring consent will need a separate appropriate choice before activation. You can manage browser storage through your browser, although disabling essential functions can prevent sign-in, conversation access or checkout from working. Our Cookie Notice gives further details.
privacy.The /loaners page lets you download a bl: Opus Loaners is intended for selected known and trusted contacts, not the general public. The /loaners page lets those contacts download a blank agreement and try a simple-interest illustration. Keeping this page out of search results does not make its link or downloadable form private.

terms.An enabled automated assistant may help: Our AI-assisted tools help with service enquiries, collecting a brief and finding relevant information. AI-assisted replies are generated automatically; human support remains available.
terms.Automated replies, interactive formats a: AI-assisted replies, interactive formats and message delivery depend on Meta’s platform requirements, account status and provider availability. A customer enquiry permits a response to that enquiry, not unrelated promotional messaging. We respect requests to stop optional messages; any business-initiated messaging must follow the consent, template and customer-service-window requirements that apply.
terms.Our /loaners page provides an editable f: Opus Loaners is intended for selected known and trusted contacts and is not a public offer of credit. Our /loaners page provides those contacts with an editable funding-request and agreement document and a calculation illustration. Search exclusion does not make the page or its downloadable form access-controlled.
terms.Before work begins, the accepted quotati: Before work begins, the accepted quotation or project agreement identifies the deliverables, price, payment milestones, included revisions, required customer inputs and any recurring or third-party charges. For new website and design project quotations accepted on or after 19 November 2026, the default includes two consolidated revision rounds within the agreed brief unless the quotation expressly states otherwise. A round is one collected set of feedback on the latest work presented. Corrections needed to meet the agreed requirements are not charged as a change of scope. Website examples and indicative prices do not replace the agreement; concept visuals do not promise an identical result in every package.
terms.The quotation or checkout identifies the: The quotation or checkout identifies the amount, currency and charges payable. For new website and design project quotations accepted on or after 19 November 2026, the default payment schedule is 50% before work starts and the remaining 50% before launch or final-file handover, unless the accepted quotation expressly agrees otherwise. This default does not change an existing accepted quotation or agreement and does not apply automatically to domains, hosting, subscriptions or other services with their own payment arrangements. Taxes, recurring costs and unavoidable supplier charges will be identified where applicable before you commit. Cancellation and refunds remain subject to section 13; an initial payment is not automatically forfeited.
terms.Work outside the agreed scope, additiona: Work outside the agreed scope, additional revision rounds, major changes after approval and new integrations require an agreed change request or separate quotation before chargeable additional work proceeds. A change request sets out the requested work, price and any effect on the delivery schedule. Late-payment charges or suspension conditions must be expressly agreed; they are not created retrospectively by this website update.
terms.It can misunderstand language, context o: AI output can misunderstand language, context or informal wording.
